operating_notes.text: The company operates as a single reportable segment: manufacturing of long and flat stainless-steel products.
IPO proceeds of ₹254.98 Cr were 53% utilised by March 31, 2026, with ₹116.57 Cr temporarily in fixed deposits.
FY26 inventory build absorbed ₹49.26 Cr of cash, lifting inventories to ₹181.78 Cr from ₹132.52 Cr.
FY26 revenue from operations crossed ₹1,000 crore, standing at ₹1,006.96 crore.

holders.name: CITADEL SECURITIES INDIA MARKETS PVT LTD

timeline.summary: Rajputana Stainless submitted its Q4FY26 Monitoring Agency Report showing ₹119.64 crore of unutilised IPO proceeds.
Rajputana Stainless reported FY26 revenue of ₹1,006.96 crore and a 25.01% increase in net profit to ₹49.82 crore, recommending a final dividend of ₹0.50 per share.

status_history.evidence: Board recommended final dividend of ₹0.50 per share, subject to shareholder approval at the AGM.

watchlist.text: Shareholder approval of the ₹0.50 final dividend at the AGM
